changeSet.author: erp-pointvente
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS depenses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fournisseur_id BIGINT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS articles_detail TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deversee_compta BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS date_deversement TIMESTAMP, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ecriture_id BIGINT;
DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_depenses_fournisseur' ) THEN ALTER TABLE depenses ADD CONSTRAINT fk_depenses_fournisseur FOREIGN KEY (fournisseur_id) REFERENCES fournisseurs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; END IF; END $$;
